item.title: [Backport release-25.05] lima: add meta.knownVulnerabilities
item.description:
Adding this field is a much smaller change than manually backporting https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/459093.

However, updating to 1.2.2 is not suitable for stable channels. This is because version 1.1.1 is not compatible, especially on the package manager side.

I considered just copying pkg/limayaml/containerd.yaml from 1.2.2 to 1.0.7. But I'm not certain about that ad-hoc change.

item.title: workflows/check: run codeowners validator from trusted checkout
item.description:
In https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/f7d6d11e8e8e046faaa6fbc55c2c1312e967cf04 I wrongly assumed that running from the untrusted checkout should be fine for the codeowners validator, because we removed all the logic for privileged tokens. However, this job also contains access to the cachix secret, which could be used to push malicious code to cachix, which would then be pulled by a more privileged workflow like reviewers.yml later.

To prevent attackers from running the insecure workflow version on older branches, I will disable the pr.yml workflow entirely. Thus, the second commit renames this workflow to pull-request-target.yml. This is similar to how #351446 handled this. As mentioned in the commit message, nixpkgs-review should not be affected because it looks for the user-visible name, not the filename.

cc @NixOS/security
